description:
About our brand and products

Authorized Vac & Sew is an authorized retailer of high-quality vacuums, sewing machines, parts, and accessories from trusted, well-known brands. We focus on real, in-demand physical products that customers actively search for, with reliable fulfillment and customer support handled by our team.

What makes us different

We’re a real, established business — not a one-off digital offer. Our products have strong buyer intent, competitive pricing, and repeat purchase potential. We value long-term affiliate partnerships, offer transparent tracking, and protect both customer trust and affiliate credibility.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn commission on qualifying sales generated through their unique tracking links. Commission rates vary by product category, allowing us to stay competitive while protecting margins. Affiliates earn 2% commission on machines, software, vacuums, furniture, and other high-ticket items, and 10% commission on notions and accessories. Exclusions do apply. Payouts are reliable, and performance-driven affiliates have opportunities to scale.

How to promote us

Affiliates can promote Authorized Vac & Sew through:

  • Blogs and review sites

  • YouTube and social media content

  • Email marketing

  • Paid traffic (where compliant)

We encourage honest product reviews, comparisons, and educational content that helps customers make informed buying decisions.

Other information

We handle order processing, shipping, and customer support, so affiliates can focus solely on traffic and conversions. Fast processing, clear policies, and responsive support help ensure a smooth experience for both affiliates and customers.se
term_and_condition:
Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

By joining the Authorized Vac & Sew Affiliate Program, you agree to promote our products in a truthful, ethical, and professional manner. Affiliates may share approved links and content on websites, blogs, social media, and other approved platforms. Spam, misleading claims, false advertising, coupon misuse, or trademark bidding without permission is not allowed.

Commissions are earned on qualifying purchases tracked through your unique affiliate link. Affiliate payouts are issued 30 days after a completed sale to allow time for cancellations, returns, or refunds. Orders that are canceled, returned, refunded, or found to be fraudulent are not eligible for commission, and any related commissions may be withheld or reversed. Commission rates, payout schedules, and minimum payout thresholds may change at any time.

Affiliate commissions are based on product category. A 2% commission applies to all sewing machines, embroidery machines, vacuum cleaners, software, quilting frames, sewing furniture, cabinets, tables, ironing systems (including brands such as Laurastar), and other high-ticket items. A 10% commission applies to notions, accessories, bags, totes, luggage, parts, and other qualifying non-machine items.

Commissions are calculated on the product subtotal only and exclude taxes, shipping, handling, discounts, and fees. The following are not eligible for commission: classes, events, labor or service charges, repairs, warranties, price-matched orders, clearance items, and certain promotions or special offers. Additional exclusions may apply, and commission rates are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Authorized Vac & Sew.

Affiliate Commission Hold & Backorder Policy

Affiliate commissions are subject to a standard 30-day holding period from the date of the customer’s purchase. This holding period allows time to account for potential refunds, cancellations, payment issues, or order adjustments before commissions are approved for payout.

In rare cases where an item is placed on backorder and cannot be fulfilled immediately, commission payment will be delayed until the customer’s order has been fully shipped and delivered. Some backordered items may take an extended period of time to become available, we have seen up to several months in rare cases up to a year. If this occurs, we will notify the affiliate of the delay and provide updates on the payment status. Commissions for backordered items will not be paid until the associated order has been successfully completed and delivered to the customer.

Authorized Vac & Sew reserves the right to approve, deny, suspend, or terminate any affiliate account at our discretion.
